title: Libre 1, MiaoMiao 2 and SSW3 why won't it work away from phone!
body:
Hello

Firstly massive thanks for creating the Xdrip app it is truly brilliant and I owe you a debt of gratitude.

Now on to my issue. I got my hands on a SSW 3 and although I can get it to easily display what is on my phone as soon as the watch is out of range it no longer gets readings. I have followed all the instructions online and tried every setting I can see but still cannot get it to read from the Miao Miao without the phone. I know the watch is connected to the MiaoMiao as it shows the "Wear" battery rather than "collector" battery but it just doesn't update any readings and goes to strikethrough after about 10mins.

I was really hoping to wear this watch whilst surfing and cannot take the phone with me so I am a bit gutted it doesn't seem to work. Can anyone help me with this?

Once again thanks for the App, I really hope someone can help me and thus assist me getting back out on the waves in confidence!

comments.body: I have an opposite problem with MM2/SSW3. I use SSW3 as the primary collector device, but when the smartwatch is out of range, the collector function is not activated on the smartphone, so I need to toggle it manually.

@Left-moment Would you please close this issue if it has been resolved?
Otherwise, would you please update?
You can get a lot of useful information from the user community also.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
